title: PR Set, Jokers and First Set Last
author: Alasdair Botting
desc:
3/5/1 programing

Joker sets are extra works sets added above the highest percentage set for the day. These are usually done for 1-2 sets of 1-3 reps at a 5-10% increase above the highest set of the day

85% Training Max for most lifters

Conditioning:
2-3 days of hard conditioning.
3-5 days of easy conditioning.
